# graviteeam_service_resource (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Service Resource (SMTP, Twilio, Infobip)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_service_resource" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "SMTP Server"
  type      = "smtp-am-resource"
  configuration = jsonencode({
    host           = "smtp.example.com"
    port           = 587
    from           = "noreply@example.com"
    protocol       = "smtp"
    authentication = true
    startTls       = true
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String, Sensitive) JSON configuration for the resource plugin
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the service resource
- `type` (String) The resource plugin type (e.g. smtp-am-resource, twilio-verify-am-resource)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the service resource
